steps.summary: Seventeen font sizes and four weights collapse into a seven-step ladder with two weights, and the title and headings move into the serif the article is read in.

changes.what: Article title set in the reading serif, one size for every width instead of a 34–60px fluid sans
Body text a size smaller, inside the editorial range
Section headings in the serif, smaller, so the reading stays loudest
Pull quote no longer outgrows the heading above it
changes.after: 24px, equal to the heading, parted by regular weight and italic

changes.what: Uppercase tracked labels become sentence case
Fewer distinct sizes and weights
changes.before: 17 font sizes, 4 weights (400/500/600/700), 9 font styles requested
changes.after: 7 sizes above the 12px floor plus code, 2 weights (400/600), 5 styles requested; JetBrains Mono dropped for a system mono

changes.what: Bold and missing styles locked to the system
changes.before: no font-synthesis rule; card and author titles at the browser's 700
changes.after: font-synthesis: none; strong and titles at 600

steps.summary: The orange that was on fourteen different things is spent once — on Subscribe, the page's only offer — and every grey now clears contrast on the surface it actually sits on.

changes.what: Orange removed from decoration: drop cap, kicker, bullets, quote bar, progress bar, avatars, card meta, links, hovers, callout
changes.after: accent on focus only, plus one named exception (Subscribe)

changes.what: Subscribe button text readable on its fill
changes.before: white on #e8590c (hover, footer button): 3.58:1; dark theme 2.60:1

changes.what: Quietest grey passes on the tinted band and table caption
Body copy in the primary ink instead of a secondary grey
Code comments readable; syntax shown by weight and tier instead of six hues
changes.after: comment 6.48:1; keywords bold, strings one tier down, no hues

changes.what: Green pills removed from the table's results
changes.law: color law 7 (done is not the news)

changes.what: Footer email field edge visible
changes.after: 3.44:1 on the field, 3.89:1 on the band

changes.what: One neutral hue instead of cool text on warm paper
changes.before: text greys OKLCH C 0.018–0.019 at h 263; lines at h 86

steps.summary: Lines of text shorten from about 83 characters to about 70, the cover and head pull in to match, the table loses its box, and the side rails fold into the column on narrower screens instead of disappearing.

changes.what: Shorter reading lines
Cover and article head narrowed to 1.5 × the text column
Data table unframed, its edges flush with the text
changes.before: boxed: border, 14px radius, shadow, tinted caption strip, row hover wash
changes.after: no frame; 1px rule under the head, 0.5px between rows, caption below

changes.what: Contents and share stay available below the wide breakpoint
changes.after: below 1248px: a closed 'On this page' disclosure with the share row beside it

changes.what: Heading space on a ratio
One radius ladder
changes.after: 4 / 8 / 12 / 16px and pill; focus ring follows the element

changes.what: Kicker becomes a text link, not a pill
changes.after: 1 chip shape (tags, footer pill); kicker underlined text

changes.what: Hover effects only on devices that hover

steps.summary: Shadows and boxes come off everything that sits in the page; the callout becomes a ruled note, and the frosted header gets fallbacks and text that stays readable over the dark cover.

changes.what: Shadows removed from content
changes.before: 5 shadowed surfaces (cover, code, table, author card, post-card hover)
changes.after: 0; the sticky header is the only raised surface

changes.what: Callout drawn as a note with a rule, not a tinted box
changes.law: depth law 2 (asides are a ruled note)
changes.after: 1px rule on the leading edge, no fill

changes.what: Author bio unboxed
changes.after: on the page, grouped by space under the tags rule

changes.what: Header links readable when the dark cover scrolls under the frosted header
Frosted header has an opaque baseline and preference fallbacks
changes.before: blur 14px, no @supports guard, no reduced-transparency branch
changes.after: opaque by default; blur 20px + saturate 1.8 inside @supports; opaque under reduced transparency; stronger edge under high contrast and forced colours

steps.summary: The cover's endless animation plays a few times and stops, nothing hops on hover any more, and every transition uses one set of named timings.

changes.what: Cover packets stop instead of looping forever
changes.after: 2–4 passes then rest (subject motion, hidden under reduced motion)

changes.what: Related-post cards no longer lift on hover
'All posts' arrow no longer nudges
Press feedback on buttons
Named timings instead of typed ones

steps.summary: Controls now do what they look like they do: Copy link copies, email share opens mail, and the sign-up field has a visible label.

changes.what: Copy link is a working button that says 'Copied'
changes.after: <button> copying the address; share label reads 'Copied' for 2s (aria-live)

changes.what: Email share opens a mail draft
changes.after: mailto: with the article title as subject

changes.what: Subscribe field has a visible label
